title: Concerning the Three Blows that befell the Enemy because of the Light.
text:
⟨p.105⟩
(paragraphos)
— > · Concerning the Three Plagues which they
ⲙⲁ > · strike against the Enemy on account of the Light · < ⲙⲁ
{9}Once again, at this hour he said: 'The Darkness, also—the Enemy—
—because three bitter plagues, with three wars, and
bitter dangers (have come) through the Light, in this third war
of theirs.
The First: that they took him from the midst, they separated them
to his land of Darkness—who had gone forth from him; they reigned
over him in this first war; they reckoned him, they
{11}-bound him in the Living Principle.
The Second Plague
is the time when there is a release-forth, a separation-forth, a dividing in
the Great Fire; and they shall destroy and shake forth the icons—
which are all those things that are hidden in them—and they shall be gathered inward
{12} the bond, according to its first type, in the manner in which they were
{13}existing in her from the very first.
{14}The Third Plague that strikes the Enemy is the carrying-off
{15} of the last (era), when they shall separate every thing forth, and they shall separate the male
{16}the female. The male, indeed, they shall bind in the bōlos; the fe-
{17}, also, shall be {18} in{19}ward to the tomb. For they shall reach
{20} of stone in their midst, unto generation
{21} ever.
⟨p.106⟩
Such is the manner in which the fruit of the Enemy shall come to be in a heav{0}
{0}en, bitter and hard, in which there is no dissolution forth, existing in
her forever; but {1} him with splittings, they have split him forever;
they have split him with separations forth, they have separated him forth forever.
Therefore I say it to my beloved ones: hear my words
which I declare to you. Gird yourselves into the works of
{2} and bear up under the {3}-trials and the temptations that
{4} to you. Strengthen yourselves in the commandments which I have
given {5}, that you may be saved from the second death
yonder, and that you may go forth from the last fruit, in which there is no hope of
{6} in it; and that you may be saved out of the evil end of the de
niers and the blasphemers — those who saw without truth (with) their eyes; they looked
back behind into her, those who shall (go) to the place of puni{7}shment, that {8}
has no days of life in it; for hidden away from {9} there is, namely{10},
the Light that gives light, and they shall not see it from this moment
forth; the air and the wind shall be drawn from them, and they shall not receive breath of
life in them; from this moment shall the wat-
ers be taken from them, and the dews; and they shall not be taken up to heaven there for their {11}refreshment.
These (are) for everyone who shall be saved out of the evil end of the sin-
ners and the deniers, and (he) shall escape the snare that is set for them forever.
